author: GalaxyBen
body:
Well, this is my Looking for a Team.

Let me tell you why I would benefit a team.

Rushing: I rush. I have special rushing strategies that I use to rush. I am not the best rusher but I would certainly be applicable for a rushing team. Yes, I don't have the most monuments, but I don't always rush every game and I only just started.

PvP: I can almost jitter click to 8-9 cps. Not much here for PvP because I basically summed it up. Most people rate me about 6-8 out of 10 when PvPing.

Cannoning: I only know one cannon at the current moment and that is Icarus. But if people show me a cannon I can more than likely repeat it. I learn that way.

Traits:

Ninja Bridger

Good Luck all people looking for a team.

Thanks, Ben
